gdp_vintage: NSO GRDP per person × average population, 2024 (preliminary)

currency.note: VND converted at the World Bank official rate for 2024: 24,165 VND per USD.

yields.label: Food
yields.description: Paddy rice harvested in the year, in tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2024, preliminary). Rice is the food yield because it is Vietnam's staple and the one crop counted in every province.

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Employed workers aged 15 and over, counted where they live (NSO Labour Force Survey via the Statistical Yearbook 2024). NSO does not publish workers by industry for each province.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross regional domestic product (GRDP) in 2024 at current prices, converted at the World Bank official rate for 2024. NSO publishes GRDP per person; the total is per person × average population.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: University students enrolled in the province's universities, 2023 (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2024). Provinces without a university count zero.

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: Turnover of travel agencies and tour operators in 2024, in US dollars (NSO). It is the one tourism figure NSO publishes for every province; visitor counts are not published by province.
